categories.main_business_segments: Kengic Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in intelligent logistics, intelligent manufacturing, and new energy sectors. The company provides integrated solutions covering intelligent logistics systems, intelligent warehousing, intelligent factories, and core equipment, including software and hardware products. It serves industries such as express delivery, e-commerce, new energy (especially lithium batteries), tire manufacturing, automotive parts, and cold chain logistics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including adaptive control for high-speed automated conveyor systems, RFID and barcode tracking, 3D camera-based detection, neural network-based multi-agent control, and embedded industrial controllers. It develops modular, parameterized, and standardized equipment such as automated guided vehicles (AGVs), stacker cranes, sorting systems, and warehouse management software (WMS, WCS, MES). Production involves integrated hardware manufacturing and software development with a focus on automation, digitalization, and intelligent control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading express logistics companies like SF Express and Deppon, major e-commerce platforms such as JD.com, Shopee, Coupang, Flipkart, and Trendyol, as well as large industrial clients in the tire, automotive, and new energy sectors including SAILUN Tire, Senqilin Tire, Envision Energy, and CRRC. The company serves both domestic Chinese markets and international markets across Asia, Europe, and the Middle East.
categories.geographic_coverage: Kengic operates extensively in China, with headquarters and major facilities in Qingdao, Shandong Province. It has expanded internationally with subsidiaries and projects in South Korea, Hong Kong, India, Thailand, Vietnam, Turkey, Israel, Germany, France, and the Netherlands. Overseas business accounts for over 50% of new orders, reflecting a strong global footprint in Asia, Europe, and emerging markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the design, development, manufacturing, and integration of intelligent logistics and manufacturing equipment and systems. It collaborates closely with upstream suppliers of core components and downstream customers in logistics and manufacturing industries, providing end-to-end automation and digital solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include accelerating product and technology innovation with emphasis on modularization, digitalization, and internationalization. R&D focuses on new industry solutions such as aerial shuttle vehicles, advanced sorting algorithms, intelligent driving, and digital simulation technologies. The company invests heavily in expanding its R&D team and capabilities, aiming to enhance product technical barriers and value-added features, especially in intelligent logistics, smart warehousing, and new energy manufacturing.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of intelligent logistics and manufacturing systems and equipment, including hardware and software solutions. The company also earns income from after-sales services, technical consulting, and maintenance contracts. Sales are made directly to end customers and through system integrators, with a significant portion from large-scale project contracts and milestone-based payments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Kengic is positioned as a leading domestic provider of intelligent logistics and manufacturing solutions in China, recognized as a national 'specialized and innovative' enterprise. It competes with both international giants like Daifuku, Vanderlande, and Dematic in high-end markets and domestic peers such as North Automation, KunChuan Intelligent, and Today International. The company differentiates itself through comprehensive coverage of logistics, warehousing, and factory automation, strong R&D, and growing international presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Kengic achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.39 billion, representing a 21.35% year-over-year increase. Despite a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB -58.6 million, the loss narrowed compared to prior years. Total assets grew by 10.3% to RMB 2.91 billion, with net assets of RMB 1.04 billion. The company’s overseas orders and revenues have shown strong growth, with overseas new orders increasing by over 81% and overseas revenue by 150%. R&D investment accounted for nearly 7% of revenue, reflecting a growth-oriented profile.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Kengic emphasizes its unique value proposition through integrated, end-to-end intelligent logistics and manufacturing solutions that combine hardware, software, and digital services. Its products feature advanced automation, modular design, and intelligent control technologies that improve operational efficiency, accuracy, and flexibility for customers. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and customized solutions for key industries such as express logistics, e-commerce, new energy, and automotive manufacturing differentiate it from competitors. Additionally, its internationalization strategy and local market adaptation enhance its competitive edge globally.
